tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Search the UCP product and API credit catalog by keyword. Example: search_catalog(query='pass')

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: Batch lookup catalog items by product identifier list. Example: lookup_catalog(ids=['agd-pass-2000'])

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Retrieve full product or API pass metadata by product_id. Example: get_product(product_id='agd-pass-2000')

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Retrieve product pricing and variant IDs by product_id. Example: get_product_details(product_id='agd-pass-2000')

tools.name: search_shop_policies_and_faqs
tools.description: Search store privacy, refund, terms of service, and SLA policies. Example: search_shop_policies_and_faqs(query='refund')

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Create a new shopping cart with initial line items. Example: create_cart(line_items=['agd-pass-2000'])

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Retrieve current shopping cart items and totals by cart_id. Example: get_cart(cart_id='cart_1')

tools.name: update_cart
tools.description: Update line item quantities in an active shopping cart. Example: update_cart(cart_id='cart_1', line_items=[])

tools.name: cancel_cart
tools.description: Cancel an active shopping cart session by cart_id. Example: cancel_cart(cart_id='cart_1')

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create a UCP checkout session for API passes or credits. Example: create_checkout(line_items=['agd-pass-2000'])

tools.name: get_checkout
tools.description: Retrieve checkout session status and totals by checkout_id. Example: get_checkout(checkout_id='chk_1')

tools.name: update_checkout
tools.description: Update buyer or payment rail details on a checkout session. Example: update_checkout(checkout_id='chk_1')

tools.name: complete_checkout
tools.description: Finalize checkout settlement via Base USDC x402 or Stripe MPP. Example: complete_checkout(checkout_id='chk_1')

tools.name: cancel_checkout
tools.description: Cancel an uncommitted checkout session by checkout_id. Example: cancel_checkout(checkout_id='chk_1')

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Retrieve fulfilled order receipt and API pass key by order_id. Example: get_order(order_id='ord_1')
